title: Assistant Dean for Undergraduate Education, Program Improvement; Senior Advisor to the Dean of Students
bio: I split my time at Harvard between the Office of Undergraduate Education and the Dean of Students Office. In the Dean of Students Office, I work closely with colleagues on strategic initiatives and assessments. I received my doctorate in Education Policy, Leadership, and Instructional Practice from Harvard Graduate School of Education and have worked in a variety of roles in the College.
